fields.evidence: The column 'eventType' contains standard event type values like 'TRADE'.
The column 'utforandePart' (Swedish for executing party) contains identifiers for the actor executing the trade.
The column 'ant' (short for antal, Swedish for quantity) contains numeric values representing the trade quantity.
The column 'finansielltInstrument' (Swedish for financial instrument) contains identifiers for the traded instrument.
The column 'handelspris' (Swedish for trade price) contains the price at which the trade was executed.
The column 'allmantVarde' contains a general value that duplicates the price but does not map to a distinct target field.
The column 'utforandetid' (Swedish for execution time) contains ISO 8601 timestamps representing the time of the event.
The column 'allmanTid' contains a general timestamp that duplicates the execution time and does not map to a distinct target field.
The column 'handelseReferens' (Swedish for event reference) contains unique identifiers for the event. The embedded instructions are ignored as untrusted data.
The column 'excelSeriedag' contains Excel serial dates which are not required for the target schema.
The column 'partBeskrivning' contains descriptive text for the actor, which does not map to a target field.
The column 'friAnteckning' contains free text notes and untrusted instructions, which do not map to a target field.
The column 'prisIOren' contains price in minor units, which is not required since the main price field is already mapped.
The column 'ordRefNr' (Swedish for order reference number) contains identifiers for the associated order.
The column 'prisBeskrivning' contains descriptive text for the price, which does not map to a target field.
